true_answer: 1.1. Additive and Multiplicative Principles 59 Example 1.1.3 Suppose you are going for some fro-yo. You can pick one of 6 yogurt choices, and one of 4 toppings. How many choices do you have? Solution . Break your choices up into disjoint events: A are the choices with the first topping, B the choices featuring the second topping, and so on. There are four events; each can occur in 6 ways (one for each yogurt flavor). The events are disjoint, so the total number of choices is 6 + 6 + 6 + 6 | 24 .
